_comment: Copy this file to config.json (which is gitignored) and fill in your key. config.json is read at runtime by the post-game AI coach.
_baselineComment: Optional. URL of a stats API returning rank-average JSON for the in-game overlay's 'you vs rank' comparison. Supports {rank}/{role}/{mode} placeholders; response may include csmPerMin, kp, kda, visionPerMin. Leave empty to use the built-in baked-in baselines.
_riotComment: Set via the app's first-run setup, not by hand. Links your Riot account so stats show even when the League client is closed. region is a code like NA/EUW/KR; riotApiKey is a personal key from developer.riotgames.com (does not expire).
